Exported Functions

group GAP_Scheduler_Exported_Functions

Functions exported by GAP Scheduler.

Functions

bool gap_sched_params_set(gap_sched_params_type_t param_type, void *pvalue, uint16_t len)

Set parameters for the GAP scheduler.

Parameters:

  • param_type -- [in] The type of parameter to set.

  • pvalue -- [in] Pointer to the parameter value.

  • len -- [in] Length of the parameter value.

Return values:

  • true -- Parameters were set successfully.

  • false -- Failed to set parameters due to invalid type or length.

Returns:

Operation result.

bool gap_sched_params_get(gap_sched_params_type_t param_type, void *pvalue, uint16_t len)

Get the parameters of the GAP scheduler.

Parameters:

  • param_type -- [in] The type of parameter to get.

  • pvalue -- [out] Pointer to the parameter value.

  • len -- [in] Length of the parameter value.

Return values:

  • true -- Parameters were retrieved successfully.

  • false -- Failed to retrieve parameters due to invalid length.

Returns:

Operation result.

void *gap_sched_task_get(void)

Get the advertising buffer from the GAP scheduler.

All advertising must be sent by the GAP scheduler, and shall be allocated with the buffer first.

void gap_sched_try(gap_sched_task_t *ptask)

Attempt to schedule a task in the GAP scheduler.

This function attempts to schedule the given task within the GAP scheduler framework. It does not guarantee the task will be scheduled immediately and should be used in conjunction with task management logic to handle deferred or pending tasks. The task structure should be obtained using the gap_sched_task_get function, and the user must perform any necessary initialization before calling this function.

if gap scheduler is busy, then enqueue task and quit TRUE: idle FALSE: busy, maybe high prio task is running, maybe low prio should be stopped.

Parameters:

ptask -- [in] Pointer to the task structure that needs to be scheduled.

void gap_sched_scan(bool on_off)

Enable or disable scan of the GAP scheduler.

The scan is performed in the background.

Parameters:

on_off -- [in] The scan state: true for on, false for off.

void gap_sched_handle_bt_status_msg(mesh_inner_msg_t *pmsg)

Handle the Bluetooth status message.

The GAP scheduler needs to process Bluetooth messages.

Parameters:

pmsg -- [in] The Bluetooth status message.

void gap_sched_handle_adv_report(T_LE_SCAN_INFO *ple_scan_info)

Handle the advertising report.

The GAP scheduler needs to process the advertising report.

Parameters:

ple_scan_info -- [in] The advertising report.

bool gap_sched_link_check(void)

Check if there are link-related activities.

This includes attempting to connect or being connected.

Return values:

  • true -- Activities exist.

  • false -- No activities.

Returns:

The check result.
